label: r517-join
sql: EXPLAIN FORMATTED SELECT v.source_system,v.rel_type_id,v.id,v.source_type,v.source_id,v.target_type,v.target_id,v.order_key,v.schema_revision,v.entity_version,v.props_json,v.retained_json,v.source_feed,v.source_epoch,v.source_position,CAST(v.published_at AS STRING) AS published_at,v.apply_batch_id,v.source_cursor_json,v.source_delivery_id,v.lookup_hash FROM client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.current_index_r513 VERSION AS OF 1 i JOIN client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.immutable_carrier_r513 VERSION AS OF 2 v ON i.lookup_hash=v.lookup_hash AND i.source_system=v.source_system AND i.rel_type_id=v.rel_type_id AND i.id=v.id AND i.carrier_version=v.entity_version AND i.carrier_fingerprint=v.carrier_fingerprint WHERE NOT i.is_deleted AND i.lookup_hash=:hash AND i.source_system=:source AND i.rel_type_id=CAST(:type AS BIGINT) AND i.id=CAST(:id AS BIGINT) AND v.lookup_hash=:hash AND v.source_system=:source AND v.rel_type_id=CAST(:type AS BIGINT) AND v.id=CAST(:id AS BIGINT)
